description: Known browser/server divergences in the shared conformance suite (tests/conformance/suite), per case, runner (ts = FormEngine + WASM evaluator, rust = native formspec-eval) and leg (P, S, F, F_submit, FR, noInvention, value, text), with the exact problem lines the leg reports. A listed leg must fail with exactly its recorded problems and an unlisted leg must pass; each fix deletes its entries, and epic fs-p4kg closes when this file is deleted. See formspec/thoughts/plans/evaluator-parity.md §2.7.
